newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM says facing EU probe over pricing.
newsitem.headline: KLM says facing EU probe over pricing.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines said on Tuesday it was being investigated by the European Commission over its practices against cut-price British airline EasyJet.
A KLM spokeswoman said officials from the Commission visited KLM's head office in February and took away documents.
"They are investigating the way KLM has been competing with EasyJet on the Amsterdam-London route," spokeswoman Marjolein Wenting told Reuters.
"According to us, we didn't do anything which was not in line with EU legislation," she added.
EasyJet launched flights between Luton Airport, outside London, and Amsterdam in 1995, undercutting the prices charged by the Dutch carrier for flights between Amsterdam and London.
KLM responded by cutting its fares, prompting EasyJet to accuse the Dutch airline of predatory pricing and abusing its dominant market position.
EasyJet also launched legal action against KLM and lodged a formal complaint with the EU.
Wenting also said KLM had never described the visit by EU officials as a raid, adding that it was normal practice during an investigation.
